This is Volume 1 of a four-volume series, comprised as follows:  Volume 1: Bituminous Coal and Natural Gas to Electricity  Volume 2: Coal to Synthetic Natural Gas and Ammonia (Various Coal Ranks)  Volume 3: Low Rank Coal and Natural Gas to Electricity  Volume 4: Bituminous Coal to Liquid Fuels The cost and performance of fossil fuel-based generation technologies represented in this report (and the series at large) are important inputs to assessments and determinations of technology combinations to be utilized to meet the projected demands of future power markets.
